QuestInfo.name: Dress for Kyrin
QuestInfo.1: The dress for Kyrin is finally done. It looks so nice! I should hurry and bring the dress to #bBlack Bark#k.
QuestInfo.2: I wonder if Miss Kyrin will be wearing the dress at her birthday party. Can't wait to see her in the dress!

1.0: Ahh, you're back! Let's see the dress!

yes.0: Oh, you're so talented. Pretty... Very pretty! All of our crewmen will be happy to see this. Hey, you want to come to my birthday party with that? Don't be shy...everyone should see it!

npc.0: Please deliver the dress to Black Bark. You didn't forget it, did you?

item.0: Hey, did you forget something? Where is the dress you got from Mrs. Ming Ming?

lost.0: Good thing I have an extra dress that I made with spare materials. It took me a lot of time and effort to make this. Don't lose it again!

0.0: Okay, good thing I have started on the basic stuff already, because I am done with the dress now! Please give this to Black Bark, and tell him... that I'll be charging him for this dress shortly. Hahahaha!

yes.0: Please make sure that this dress doesn't get wrinkled, and since the fabric is very thin, it may get ripped. I suggest you deliver this to #bBlack Bark#k now. He hates waiting...

no.0: Are you avoiding Black Bark because he scares you? He may look intimidating, but... he hasn't even held a girl's hand yet. Hahaha... not even my hands back in the day... hey, what am I saying? Haha....
